title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.19 is a public research preview of a fail-closed checker for typed mathematical and scientific claims. It adds one closed finite-census empirical kernel using exact rational measurement enclosures, affine interval extremization, complete declared-frame coverage, and a required positive guard band. A registered replay may support empirically_passed only for the exact conditional finite-frame proposition; four hash-identified external premises, causation, population generalization, independent replication, and deployment authority remain separate and unresolved. Manifest 0.5.0 and the census certificate 0.1.0 are new; older schemas and theorem semantics remain accepted. Exact conclusions remain bound to subject, evidence, predicate, scope, method, and authority. Release assets are built from exact tagged Git objects, keylessly attested before publication, and redownloaded for byte comparison. The protocol component remains byte-identical to 0.3.0-alpha.13, and the live Custom GPT remains the separately observed alpha.10 interface; the alpha.19 generated package is only an unvalidated future live-update candidate and indexed Knowledge bytes remain NON_ADMISSIBLE_UNHASHABLE. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
